movies.title: Inside Out
movies.overview: A girl's emotions, Joy, Sadness and others, guide her through a big move.
movies.takeaway: Shows kids that every feeling, even sadness, has a purpose. A gentle way to start conversations about emotions.
movies.advisory: Brief tense scene in the memory dump; themes of homesickness and sadness.

movies.title: WALL·E
movies.overview: A lonely robot cleans an abandoned Earth and finds a purpose, and a friend.
movies.takeaway: A near-wordless story about caring for the planet and for each other. Sparks curiosity about robots and waste.
movies.advisory: Mild cartoon peril (robot chases); a few tense moments aboard the ship.

movies.title: Hidden Figures
movies.overview: Three brilliant Black women mathematicians help launch NASA's first astronauts into orbit.
movies.takeaway: Real women who used math and determination to beat barriers and help send people to space. Inspires teens toward STEM.
movies.advisory: Depicts racial segregation and discrimination; brief mild language.

movies.title: The Wild Robot
movies.overview: A robot stranded on a wild island learns to survive and raise an orphaned gosling.
movies.takeaway: A robot learns to care, adapt and protect a family it chose. Warm look at nature, kindness and problem solving.
movies.advisory: Predator attacks and a storm sequence may frighten under-7s; some animal death.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.overview: A girl must work in a spirit-world bathhouse to rescue her parents.
movies.takeaway: A brave girl grows from timid to resourceful by working hard and staying kind. Beautiful on imagination and respect for nature.
movies.advisory: Some eerie spirits and a transformation scene (parents turn into pigs) may scare younger kids.
